notes.title: QoL Update
notes.notes:
Hello Bananas!

QoL Changes
Today we have some changes regarding QoL (Quality Of Life) changes. That makes it easier to spot different types of bananas inside the game, search and filter them out as well. (The filter does not save between game sessions)

Oh and we've updated the game to reduce the storage usage! (Unninstalling & installing is recommended!)

Normal Bananas - The Huge Quantity

So, we've been seeing, for a while, that the normal banana quantity is still increasing, really fast.
So, we're gonna give it another purpose within the game to make it useful and clean some inventories.
(BTW! There's a delete button if you think you have too many of any banana, you can delete them from your inventory!)

We're changing the usage of the exchanging system to add the requirement of an X amount of normal bananas per rarity of which it's exchanging to, to simplify here's how it goes:

Exchange System Update:

 10 x Normal > Common - No Change
 10 x Common [color=lightgreen]+ 2 Normal[/color] > Uncommon
 10 x Uncommon [color=lightgreen]+ 4 Normal[/color] > Rare
 10 x Rare [color=lightgreen]+ 8 Normal[/color] > Epic
 10 x Epic [color=lightgreen]+ 16 Normal[/color] > Ultra Rare
 10 x Ultra Rare [color=lightgreen]+ 32 Normal[/color] > Legendary

Color Explanation:
([color=lightgreen]Light Green[/color] = New)

 Added a line to differentiate the rarities between bananas
 Added an icon to differentiate between the "O"riginal, "E"xchanged and "S"tore/Item Store bananas
 Added Search Bar, to find the bananas inside your inventory
 Added filters, to filter out whatever you wanna filter out
 Added "Total Items" label, to tell you how many bananas in total you have

[UI/Exchange]

 Added a popup error message when a user does not have enough normal bananas to exchange


- The Banana Team

notes.title: Banana Drop Pool Update & Answering a Stacking Question
notes.notes:
Hello Bananas!

Before we release more Autumn 2024 Collection bananas we're updating the drop chance for the bananas.

Why?
A: From our calculations, if we kept the same drop chances, it would increase the higher rarity bananas' number, which would decrease their actual value. The more there are the less value they have, and that's the opposite of what we want.

Why only now?
A: Only now we have an idea of the number of bananas that can be created and we have more statistics on what can happen. And with the exchange system, it will go down more smoothly in terms of bananas not circulating (being exchange into higher rarities).

So here are the new drop chances!
([color=#FF474D]Old[/color] [color=orange]>[/color] [color=lightgreen]New[/color])

 Normal - [color=#FF474D]54%[/color] [color=orange]>[/color] [color=lightgreen]70%[/color]
 Common - [color=#FF474D]30%[/color] [color=orange]>[/color] [color=lightgreen]25%[/color]
 Uncommon - [color=#FF474D]10%[/color] [color=orange]>[/color] [color=lightgreen]4.89%[/color]
 Rare - [color=#FF474D]4%[/color] [color=orange]>[/color] [color=lightgreen]0.1%[/color]
 Epic - [color=#FF474D]2%[/color] [color=orange]>[/color] [color=lightgreen]0.01%[/color]
 Ultra Rare - [color=#FF474D]1 in 4 000 000[/color] [color=orange]>[/color] [color=lightgreen]1 in 400 000[/color]
 Legendary - [color=#FF474D]1 in 28 000 000[/color] [color=orange]>[/color] [color=lightgreen]1 in 10 000 000[/color]


What stacking question?

We noticed there's been some confusion with the exchange system and exchanged bananas, so we'll try to clear it up as much as possible - sorry if it’s caused any confusion!


 Any banana you get from the exchange system will have the "Origin Exchanged" tag.
 Whether you use exchanged or dropped bananas, the result will always be an "Exchanged" banana. 

Pretty straightforward, right?

Now, a few of you pointed out that exchanged bananas aren’t stacking with dropped bananas.
We’re working on a way to visually show the difference between dropped and exchanged bananas. Here’s why that matters:


 Some people have spent serious cash on their dropped bananas, and now the same ones can pop up from exchanges
 We want to make sure that if you own a dropped banana, you can still flex your original, earned version.


(There's gonna be a visual difference that will not impact how the banana itself looks, more so as a colored symbol/text in the tags section when you hover over the banana in the market that kind of "jumps" in your sight so you really can't miss it and also in-game and inventory there will be this slight visual indicator)

- The Banana Team

notes.notes:
Hello @Bananas

We've made an update to the drop system!

Previously we had 2 drop pools, where in 1 of them you could only get commons or normals, called the "Common Drop Pool".
And one of the you could get a rare with a chance of a higher rarity banana, called the "Rare Drop Pool".

BUT, since the "rare" drop pool wasn't actually "rare", everyone would either get one or a ultra rare or legendary, we've updated the drop system to ACTUALLY use %'s but, in 1 drop pool only!

So, the NEWLY UPDATED DROP POOL with PERCENTAGES WOO!

Removed 18 hour drop pool

Updated 3 hour drop pool to the following*:

58% Normal
34% Common
8% or to be exact 7.999999714285% ~ Rare
1/4 000 000 Ultra Rare
1/28 000 000 Legendary


Good luck! :wink:

* Subject to change
